description: Look up a town in the Astrodai atlas (towns above about 15,000 people; places at or beyond 66 degrees latitude are not supported). Returns up to 5 candidates, each with a place_token for the other tools. Add the region or country after a comma to narrow the search. If nothing matches, try the nearest larger town.

place.description: Town name, optionally followed by a comma and the region or country.
